name: @useful-machinery/run-action
description: Run one local Useful Machinery Workflow V1 invocation from GitHub Actions.

scripts.build: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/build.ts dist && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/licenses.ts dist/licenses.txt
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run license:check && npm run bundle:check
scripts.format: prettier --write .github/workflows/check.yml action.yml release-evidence.json traceability.json eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json package.json scripts src tests examples/resolve-pr-conflicts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .github/workflows/check.yml action.yml release-evidence.json traceability.json eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json package.json scripts src tests examples/resolve-pr-conflicts
